about: The VFX lane's fixed questions for the parts library (P0): new effects in a brief's words (keywords = what a session would type into today's library search), written before any method was run on them. Every method's top answers are pooled and labelled blind by two labellers (labels.json); `kit parts vfx eval` scores each method on them. Add a question only from real work, never to suit a method.

questions.brief: lightning strike: dark clouds gather overhead, a jagged bolt cracks down to the ground, a white flash and a burst of sparks, a scorched ring on the ground
healing aura: soft green motes rise around the body in a slow spiral, a gentle glow pulses at the feet, leaves drift, then it fades out
meteor impact: a burning rock streaks down with a fire trail, hits with a huge explosion, a shockwave ring, flying rocks and a dust cloud, a crater left behind
ice spikes: frost cracks spread across the ground, a line of ice spikes bursts upward one after another, shards fly, cold mist lingers
teleport dash: the body breaks into dark particles, a streak of afterimages along the path, it reappears in a puff of smoke with a flash
sword wave: a slash releases a crescent of energy that flies forward, cutting a trench in the ground, and explodes where it hits
summoning circle: a glowing magic circle with runes draws itself on the floor, light columns rise from it, a creature's silhouette forms in a flash
poison cloud: a green toxic gas spreads low over the ground, bubbles pop, drips fall, damage ticks with small flashes
ground pound: the fighter lands from the air, the ground cracks in a star, rocks fly up, a dust ring rolls outward, the camera shakes
questions.keywords: ground slam cracks rocks dust shake

questions.brief: charged laser: energy gathers into a bright core between the hands, then fires a thick beam with a glowing halo, sparks where it hits
